depth_justification: Questions reference real app specifics (Bluetooth inhaler, paediatric 6-16, EN/DE/FR, peak flow, adherence streaks, parent dashboard) but the transcript ignores the developer's explicit invitation to 'sketch what good looks like,' misses the central paediatric medical-device and children's-data-consent risks, and shows little progression with repeated user answers.
actionability_justification: Every assistant turn is a single bare question with zero mitigations, it ignored the developer's two explicit requests to provide concrete guidance, and it produced no report at all when the structured deliverable was requested—answering with yet another question instead.
